## architecture - Component Architecture (HIGH)
- `architecture-avoid-boolean-props` [CRITICAL] - Avoid Boolean Prop Proliferation - prevents unmaintainable component variants (composition, props, architecture)
- `architecture-compound-components` - Use Compound Components - enables flexible composition without prop drilling (composition, compound-components, architecture)

## state - State Management (MEDIUM)
- `state-context-interface` [HIGH] - Define Generic Context Interfaces for Dependency Injection - enables dependency-injectable state across use-cases (composition, context, state, typescript, dependency-injection)
- `state-decouple-implementation` - Decouple State Management from UI - enables swapping state implementations without changing UI (composition, state, architecture)
- `state-lift-state` [HIGH] - Lift State into Provider Components - enables state sharing outside component boundaries (composition, state, context, providers)

## patterns - Implementation Patterns (MEDIUM)
- `patterns-children-over-render-props` - Prefer Composing Children Over Render Props - cleaner composition, better readability (composition, children, render-props)
- `patterns-explicit-variants` - Create Explicit Component Variants - self-documenting code, no hidden conditionals (composition, variants, architecture)

## react19 - React 19 APIs (MEDIUM)
- `react19-no-forwardref` - React 19 API Changes - cleaner component definitions and context usage (react19, refs, context, hooks)
